description.en: Review changes: the working tree against HEAD, two refs, an agent's proposed diff or a run's diff, side by side or inline, with comments and per-hunk accept or reject.
description.ja: 変更をレビュー: 作業ツリーとHEAD、2つの参照、エージェントが提案した差分、実行の差分を左右またはインラインで表示し、コメントとハンクごとの承認・却下ができます。

scopes.workspace:read: Find the repository of the workspace you are in.
scopes.git:read: Read git status and diffs of that repository.
scopes.diff:read: Open diffs that agents and runs propose to you.
scopes.feed:read: Open the review request an agent sent you.

optionalScopes.git:write: Stage or discard a hunk when you click Stage or Discard.
optionalScopes.diff:write: Record your accept, reject and comments on a proposed diff.
optionalScopes.feed:write: Send your review back to the agent that asked for it.
optionalScopes.embed:run: Show file diffs in your editor app.

handles.diff: Open a diff resource that an agent or an automation proposed to you.
handles.document: Show one file of a diff in your editor app.

editorApp.title: Editor app for file diffs
editorApp.description: Used when you have not chosen a default editor for the file type.

fallbackLines.title: Lines per file in the built-in view before Show More
